quote: How does “when will I get my money back” find “refund timing”?
agentPrompt: Support natural-language retrieval and exact matching for IDs and names. Filter by permissions and effective version, then return candidates with inspectable source passages.
html:
Semantic Search

Retrieving content by related meaning rather than only matching identical words.

In practice

A refund-timing passage can be a candidate even when it does not repeat the question. Check its date, scope and access permissions.

What to check

Use semantic retrieval for natural-language questions; retain keyword matching for order IDs and exact product names.

Common confusion

A similarity score is not the probability that an answer is correct. Opposing or outdated passages may still be similar.

Tell your agent

Support natural-language retrieval and exact matching for IDs and names. Filter by permissions and effective version, then return candidates with inspectable source passages.
